stem: Which of these describes information that can appear in a consumer's credit report?

options.label: A
options.text: The name of a store where the consumer pays cash for all purchases

options.label: B
options.text: The name of a company that gave the consumer a car loan two years ago

options.label: C
options.text: The amount of money the consumer will need to borrow in the next five years

options.label: D
options.text: The amount of money that the consumer loaned to a family member
